description: Modules mutated on every run and held to a floor, but not to the survivor-triage gate. Raising a floor is how this record is refreshed; lowering one is what it exists to prevent. A mutant with no covering test counts in the denominator, so adding unreachable code lowers the rate rather than hiding in it.

trustweave.code_analysis.reason: The survivor-triage gate requires a recorded proof for every survivor. This module has 353, and most are not equivalences, so those proofs cannot be written honestly. Four rounds of targeted work moved it from 77.64% to 80.39% for 367 tests; the rate of return is recorded in docs/MUTATION_TESTING.md. Running it under no control at all was the worse option, because the rate could fall and nothing would say so.
